title: Exploring ferroptosis: Unraveling its potential role in autistic spectrum disorder
title_zh: 探索铁死亡：揭示其在自闭谱系障碍中的潜在作用
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a diverse neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by ambiguous etiological mechanisms and the absence of recognized disease-modifying pharmacotherapies. Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent and lipid peroxidation-driven mechanism of regulated cell death, has been associated with neurodevelopment and neurodegeneration, prompting interest in its potential role in ASD. This narrative review consolidates from molecular and clinical studies, animal models, and in vitro systems to assess ferroptosis as a candidate mechanistic pathway, biomarker source, and therapeutic target in ASD. Peripheral transcriptomic analyses reveal differentially expressed ferroptosis-related genes, ferroptosis-based molecular clusters, and immune-activated subtype in children with ASD, facilitating the development of ferroptosis-derived diagnostic and scoring models with modest yet reproducible discrimination. Clinical data associate maladaptive polyunsaturated fatty acid profiles, increased lipid peroxidation products, and adverse docosahexaenoic acid/arachidonic acid ratio with autistic social impairments, aligning with ferroptosis-prone conditions. In rodent models, genetic or pharmacological modulation of DDIT4-PI3K/Akt signaling, Nrf2/GPX4/xCT antioxidant systems, and ferritinophagy mitigates ASD-like social deficits, repetitive behaviors, anxiety-like phenotypes, and liver pathology. Induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural progenitors from autistic children with megalencephaly exhibit heightened oxidative and iron stress, alongside active resistance to ferroptosis mediated by upregulated GPX4 and selenoprotein pathways, indicating subtype-specific ferroptosis resistance. These findings suggest a complex, context-dependent role of ferroptosis and ferroptosis resistance in ASD, interacting with immune dysregulation, redox imbalance, and peripheral organ involvement. Nevertheless, longitudinal and interventional studies integrating brain, peripheral, and cellular data are required to establish causality, define meaningful ferroptosis-related signatures, and evaluate the safety and efficacy of ferroptosis-modulating interventions.
abstract_zh: 自闭谱系障碍（ASD）是异质性较高的神经发育性疾病，病因机制不明，且缺乏公认的疾病修饰药物疗法。铁死亡是一种依赖铁并由脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡机制，已被发现与神经发育和神经退行性过程相关，因此引发了对其在ASD中潜在作用的关注。本叙述性综述整合分子与临床研究、动物模型及体外系统证据，以评估铁死亡作为ASD中的候选机制通路、生物标志物来源及治疗靶点。外周转录组分析显示ASD儿童中铁死亡相关基因的差异表达、基于铁死亡的分子亚群及免疫激活型亚型，这促进了具有一定但可重复区分能力的铁死亡衍生诊断与评分模型的发展。临床资料将单不饱和/多不饱和脂肪酸谱异常、脂质过氧化产物升高及二十二碳六烯酸/花生四烯酸比例异常与自闭社会受损联系起来，符合铁死亡易感状态。啮齿类模型中，遗传或药理调控DDIT4-PI3K/Akt信号、Nrf2/GPX4/xCT抗氧化系统以及铁蛋白自噬，可减轻ASD样的社交缺陷、重复行为、焦虑样表型和肝脏病理。来自自闭儿童且合并巨脑畸形的诱导性多能干细胞来源神经前体细胞表现出更高的氧化与铁负荷压力，并伴有上调GPX4和硒蛋白通路介导的铁死亡抗性，提示亚型特异性的铁死亡抵抗特征。上述发现表明，铁死亡及其抗性在ASD中具有复杂的情境依赖作用，并与免疫失调、氧化还原失衡及外周器官参与交互。尽管如此，仍需纵向及干预研究整合脑部、外周与细胞层面的数据，以建立因果关系、界定有意义的铁死亡相关特征，并评估调控铁死亡干预的安全性与有效性。
